mapper.delete: delete from free_query_record where create_time < #{beforeTime} order by create_time asc, id asc limit 2000
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalQueryCount, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end), 0) as todayQueryCount, coalesce(sum(case when create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval weekday(curdate()) day) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as weekQueryCount, count(distinct visitor_key) as uniqueVisitors, count(distinct case when create_time >= curdate() then visitor_key end) as todayVisitors, ( select count(*) from ( select visitor_key from free_query_record group by visitor_key having min(create_time) >= curdate() ) first_today ) as newVisitorsToday, round(case when count(distinct visitor_key) = 0 then 0 else count(*) / count(distinct visitor_key) end, 2) as avgQueriesPerUser, round(case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else sum(case when query_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(*) end, 2) as successRate, round(case when count(*) = 0 then 0 else sum(case when query_status = '0' and has_result = '0' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(*) end, 2) as noResultRate from free_query_record

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as statDate, count(*) as queryCount, count(distinct visitor_key) as visitorCount, round(sum(case when query_status = '0' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(*), 2) as successRate, round(sum(case when query_status = '0' and has_result = '0' then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(*), 2) as noResultRate from free_query_record where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date(create_time) order by date(create_time)

select id, ip_addr, query_phone, query_status, has_result, marked_count, response_time, create_time from free_query_record
and ip_addr like concat('%', #{ipAddr}, '%')
and query_phone like concat('%', #{queryPhone}, '%')
and has_result = '1'
order by create_time desc, id desc
select result_details from free_query_record where id = #{id}
